notes.title: 🛠️ New Patch Available
notes.notes:
Hear, hear Olydrians,

As many issues have been reported by the players, the team has worked on fixes to provide the best experience possible for [i]Noob – The Factionless[/i].

[b]Principal issue fixed:[/b]
[list][*]Random crashes that could appear after some gametime have been fixed
[list][*]This was due to characters’ summons causing a memory leak, on all platforms.[/list][/list]

Some cases that are not occurring anymore: 
[list][*]Game crashing after the Rainbowbeard fight
[*]Game crashing while fighting the 2nd boss in Dortös’ dungeon, no matter which one is fought first.
[*]Game crashing after the fight against the dragon on the 10th floor of the Galamadriabuyak tower.
[*]Game crashing after the fight against the Noob Guild.[/list]

Also, some global minor issues have been fixed, to improve the global experience.

notes.title: Hotfix du 23/07/21
notes.notes:
Bonjour à tous,

un mini patch aujourd'hui afin de corriger 2 soucis engendrés par le patch du 21/07/21.

- Correction des haut-faits qui n'étaient plus envoyés à Steam. (Tous les HFs réalisés pendant le bug seront automatiquement récupérés au chargement de la sauvegarde les ayant réalisés.)
- Correction du bug qui empêchait de réaliser les quêtes permettant de changer de faction.

Très bon jeu à tous et à très bientôt pour de nouveaux patchs !
